title: rubus pallidus subsp. bloxamii
intro: Rubus pallidus subsp. bloxamii, commonly known as the 'Mauritius Blackberry', is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, specifically a variant of the Rubus pallidus species. It is used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Rubus pallidus subsp. bloxamii include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and potentially anti-diabetic agent. Bioactive constituents of this plant may include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and antioxidant activities.
